title: Example: fix a stale cross-reference in a documentation file

acceptance_criteria.statement: The stale cross-reference is corrected to point at the current file/section.
No other documentation file is left contradicting the corrected reference.

claims.statement: The corrected cross-reference points at a file/section that actually exists.
The edit is present in the working tree at the stated path.
